Noel: Quick rally 10k launch post cadence for benchmark webinar. Need: X teaser (single image + 2 caption variants), LinkedIn long-form + stat card, and 20s demo clip. Also need lead routing tag `bench_launch_may` and UTMs. Who picks creative? @Samir?

Samir: I can own creative. Drop the final stat numbers and any brand lockups. Prefer svg for logo.

Priya: Stats in drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/bench/may_launch. Toplines: 54% latency reduction, 2.3x throughput, 30% cost savings. Logo packs at /assets/brand_lockups.zip

Noel: Tone: launch-friendly but credible. A/B test captions: (A) punchy benefit-first, (B) technical-first. Keep X under 180 chars.

Clara: Routing: I'll add rule to route leads to `webinar-inbound-rotation` with tag `bench_launch_may`. UTM: utm_campaign=bench_may&utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic; utm_content to be `x_teaser`/`li_long`/`clip_story`.

Link-bot: Optimal organic window: Tue 11:00 PT. Scheduling slot reserved.

Samir: Will produce PNG stat card + 20s MP4 clip (1080x1080) by Fri noon. Will include alt text.

Priya: I'll draft the two caption variants and a 3-paragraph LinkedIn post with PM quote. Drop in thread by Thu EOD.

Noel: Decision: publish Mon 11:00 PT X teaser (variant A), Tue 11:00 PT LinkedIn long + stat card, Wed 11:00 PT X reminder + register CTA. If first 24h CTR < 1% we flip CTA to "Watch on demand" and pin stat card.

Clara: Staging test for routing will run when assets live. Will report back.

Samir: Uploaded assets: https://drive.redwood.ai/edits/may_launch_assets.zip.

Priya: Copy drafts posted; small stat phrasing tweak: use "~54%" to reflect sample size.

Clara: Staging routing test passed at 15:12 PT; lead sample arrived with utm_content=x_teaser.

Noel: Great. Final checklist: Samir finalize creatives Fri noon, Priya finalize copy Thu EOD, Clara validate prod routing post publish. Closing once scheduled.

Samir: Noted, will update here when uploads complete.

Link-bot: Scheduling job queued for Mon 11:00 PT.
